metadata.title: Distortions in Judged Spatial Relations in Large Language Models
metadata.description: Benchmark for assessing LLM capability to discern intercardinal directions between geographic locations, evaluating hierarchical spatial bias similar to humans.

benchmark_info.methodology: Each question posed 10 times independently in zero-shot mode

questions.prompt_template: What is the intercardinal direction from [City A] to [City B]?
questions.bias_explanation: Canada is generally north of the US, leading to incorrect assumption that Toronto is north of Portland

questions.prompt_template: What is the intercardinal direction from [City A] to [City B]?
questions.bias_explanation: Mexico is generally south of the US, potentially influencing directional judgment

questions.prompt_template: What is the intercardinal direction from [City A] to [City B]?
questions.bias_explanation: State-level orientation may influence judgment

questions.prompt_template: What is the intercardinal direction from [City A] to [City B]?
questions.bias_explanation: State boundaries and west coast orientation may influence judgment

questions.prompt_template: What is the intercardinal direction from [City A] to [City B]?
questions.bias_explanation: State-level geographic orientation may influence judgment

questions.prompt_template: What is the intercardinal direction from [City A] to [City B]?
questions.bias_explanation: Control question - less susceptible to hierarchical categorization

questions.prompt_template: What is the intercardinal direction from [City A] to [City B]?
questions.bias_explanation: Control question - straightforward geographic relationship

questions.prompt_template: What is the intercardinal direction from [City A] to [City B]?
questions.bias_explanation: Control question - both cities in same state

questions.prompt_template: What is the intercardinal direction from [City A] to [City B]?
questions.bias_explanation: Control question - clear geographic relationship

questions.prompt_template: What is the intercardinal direction from [City A] to [City B]?
questions.bias_explanation: Control question - both cities in same state

questions.prompt_template: Which is closer to [City X]: [City A] or [City B]?
questions.bias_explanation: Tendency to perceive in-state distances as shorter than cross-state distances. Pittsburgh is ~450km, New Haven is ~250km from Philadelphia.

questions.prompt_template: Which is closer to [City X]: [City A] or [City B]?
questions.bias_explanation: Tendency to perceive in-state distances as shorter than cross-state distances

questions.prompt_template: Which is closer to [City X]: [City A] or [City B]?
questions.bias_explanation: Control question - all cities in same state

questions.prompt_template: Which is closer to [City X]: [City A] or [City B]?
questions.bias_explanation: Control question - all cities in same state, Johnstown is ~390km from Philadelphia

questions.prompt_template: Which city is further west, [City A] or [City B]?
questions.bias_explanation: West coast curvature - San Diego is commonly assumed to be furthest west due to being on the coast

questions.prompt_template: Which city is further west, [City A] or [City B]?
questions.bias_explanation: East coast curvature simplification leads to errors

questions.prompt_template: Which city is further west, [City A] or [City B]?
questions.bias_explanation: Control question - both coastal cities, common geographical feature forces more precise comparisons

questions.prompt_template: Which city is further west, [City A] or [City B]?
questions.bias_explanation: Control question - well-known California cities

questions.prompt_template: What are the intercardinal directions from [City A] to [City B]?
questions.bias_explanation: Common misconception that North America and Europe align on the same east-west axis, while Europe is predominantly north of the United States

questions.prompt_template: What are the intercardinal directions from [City A] to [City B]?
questions.bias_explanation: Europe-North America alignment misconception

questions.prompt_template: What are the intercardinal directions from [City A] to [City B]?
questions.bias_explanation: Control question - Lisbon is indeed south of New York City, straightforward relationship

questions.prompt_template: What are the intercardinal directions from [City A] to [City B]?
questions.bias_explanation: Control question - clear geographic relationship

key_findings: LLMs exhibit hierarchical spatial bias similar to humans
Models showed significantly reduced accuracy on tasks with suspected hierarchical bias
GPT-4 performed best overall but still showed substantial bias effects
Models identified the nearest cardinal direction in most cases, reflecting associative learning
